name: Doorr
tagline: Search your self-hosted torrent indexers from your phone
description:
Doorr is a search app for people who run their own Prowlarr or Jackett server to index torrents. Instead of opening a browser and logging into your server's web page, Doorr gives you a proper mobile app to search across your indexers.

It's built for the self-hosting crowd, a quick, native way to find what you're looking for from your self-hosted torrent search setup.
